items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Uncle Henry's, yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] Right, and it was 35¢ for dinner... [INTERVIEWER] ...Uncle Henry was charging us 35 or 50¢... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah!

ctx.x: Right, and it was 35¢ for dinner, and we used to call it pitch till you win. You ate as much as you could for 35¢. Can you imagine some of our friends now? If you would turn them loose at Uncle Henry's? They'd put him out of business in two days, wouldn't they?
That's right. We got a couple of them here, if we can recall their names. There was Chu Berry and Benny Carter -- very big eaters.
